theorem travel_price {C : Family G} (H : C.Makes) (F : Order) (S : Table C.book) (hs : S.Hierarchy)
    (he : F.PointLimits C S) {m k l b : ℕ} (hm : m≤k) (hk : k≤l) (hl : l≤b)
    {w : C.book.Word} (h : Slab timeAxis d w) (hd : buffer timeAxis r d w) (hc : Covered C.S d m)
    (v : Future C.book timeAxis) (hv : buffer timeAxis t e v.val) (q : ℕ)
    (hp : C.S.a m < r) (hh : C.S.a l < t)
    (headroom : (↑(2*w.length : ℕ):ℝ)*(2*(5*C.S.a k)) < C.S.a m)
    (side : (↑(2*v.val.length : ℕ):ℝ)*(2*(3*C.S.a b)) < C.S.a l)
    (A B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (ha : ∀ i∈w, F.late (Single C i.2 A k))
    (hf : ∀ j∈v.val, F.late (Single C j.2 B b)) :
    ‖S.gram timeAxis (ride h v q).val (ride h v q).val‖ ≤ B ^ (2*v.val.length) * A ^ (w.length*(4*q)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `travel_price` bounds the Gram norm of `ride h v q` by `B^(2*|v|) * A^(|w|*(4*q))` where `A` and `B` bound the main and exterior insertions.

refine ⟨X^(2*v.val.length),fun q => ?_⟩
  apply (travel_price H f S hs h hk hl hb hh hg hd v ht₂ q (hm.2.1.trans (by linarith))
    hsep hK hb₀ A X hX (fun i hi => hf k (hm.1.trans hk) i.2 (hw i hi).1 (hw i hi).2)
    (fun i hi => hq b hb' i.2 (hW i hi).1 (hW i hi).2)).trans
  rw [pow_mul A w.length]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀
    (pow_nonneg (by unfold A; have hh := C.S.a_pos k; positivity) _) ha _) (pow_nonneg hX _)

proof_context.conclusion: `replicas` instantiates it with `B := X^(2*|v|)` and `A = J*(a k)⁻¹^P`, giving the bound `X^(2|v|) (J a_k^{-P})^{|w| 4q}` for every `q`.
